trajectory_definition: daytime clear-sky-normalised transmission kt=actual_SW_IN/clearsky_ghi where clearsky_ghi>20 W/m²; raw SW_IN and clear-sky residual are retained as diagnostic concepts; no nighttime increments

thresholds.high_complexity_split: strictly above median of pre-specified standardized [transition_count, roughness, cumulative_abs_delta_kt]
